subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf14a364f6b606a0449db6b40e095354b51114f923117325140f0f24b0076b0.png]
solution:
The figure that will come in the figure series is shown below: 

**The figure is moving 45° anticlockwise direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bca9104c2133d89428d9a3b53358eef675f51120bc58782ef3b1308facc93ee.png] 

Next step:

The figure will move 45° anticlockwise from the previous step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1d952f937fe205492f0f3ef7ddfcaac7fc8248300974401777e70373c94b5f2.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/393620a4ea599e03a6da6bbaf88643eff1d9ff4d963888bc435124a2a357c61b.png] The figure moves 45° clockwise.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1678ba9bff0cde1c91bf055ad6a3db420da2e75e343dd31bab331a258badcc5d.png] The figure moves 180° anticlockwise.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c14ab1cddcf2af63d4680c1f43846ebd6b70a2988b92c525133801913c97ae0b.png] The figure moves 90° anticlockwise.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1d952f937fe205492f0f3ef7ddfcaac7fc8248300974401777e70373c94b5f2.png] The figure is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.
